_meta.critical_2d_vs_3d_caveat: GolfTEC numbers are 3D. The app measures 2D. A 2D value equals the 3D target only when the segment is square to the camera (≈ address for face-on); at top/impact the 2D projection foreshortens and under-reads. Honor each context's `two_d_comparable_now`: compare the live 2D metric to GolfTEC ONLY where it is true. The rest need the deferred two-camera 3D path (see handoff: GolfTEC-grade 3D).
_meta.golfdb_secondary: coach/norms/pro_reference/pro_reference.json supplies head/hand-depth (no GolfTEC value) and a same-projection 2D pro baseline for the rotated-position metrics until 3D exists.
_meta.precedence: GolfTEC is trusted OVER our GolfDB-deduced numbers wherever they conflict (user decision 2026-06-04). pro_reference.json (GolfDB) is secondary: gap-fill + a 2D-measured pro baseline + variability bands.
